definitions.explanation: An eyelid whose double fold is partly hidden by the skin above it, so the crease is faint or concealed near the inner edge — falling between a clear {二重|ふたえ} (double eyelid) and a {一重|ひとえ} (single eyelid).

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}は{奥二重|おくぶたえ}だ。
{奥二重|おくぶたえ}はメイクで{印象|いんしょう}が{変|か}わりやすい。
examples.english: Inner double eyelids change impression easily with makeup.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{奥二重|おくぶたえ}で、{目|め}を{閉|と}じると{一重|ひとえ}のように{見|み}える。
examples.english: She has inner double eyelids, and when she closes her eyes they look single.

notes:
An eyelid whose fold is present but partly tucked under the brow-side skin, so the crease barely shows. It sits between a clear {二重|ふたえ} (double eyelid) and a {一重|ひとえ} (single eyelid), and is a very common feature and a frequent topic in beauty and makeup contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {奥二重|おくぶたえ}の{目|め}: eyes with a hidden double fold
- {奥二重|おくぶたえ}メイク: makeup for inner double eyelids

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {二重|ふたえ}: double eyelid — visible crease
- {一重|ひとえ}: single eyelid — no crease
